notes: Only an old CARC AIP AD 2 OJAI file could be read (pages dated 21 Jul 2016, AIRAC AMDT 13/2016, to 01 May 2017, AMDT 84/2017); values may have changed since. The 2026 AIRAC amendments on carc.gov.jo (e.g. https://carc.gov.jo/sites/default/files/inline-files/AIRAC AIP AMDT 27-2026.pdf) could not be opened (site blocks automated reading), so status is partial until the current AD 2 OJAI is read. No curfew or night restriction is stated; all services are H24. The 08L/08R rows did not show dimensions in the extracted text. IATA code not shown in the AIP pages read. Re-researched 2026-10-29: 29 Oct 2026: AIRAC AIP AMDT 26/2026 (published 9 Apr 2026, effective 14 May 2026) replaces pages 2.OJAI-13 (AD 2.12 runway characteristics) and 2.OJAI-14 (AD 2.13 declared distances). These show 08L/26R as 3,668 x 61 m and 08R/26L as 3,660 x 61 m (TORA/LDA 3,668 and 3,660 m), so the existing runway fact ('26L and 26R each 3,660 m') is replaced; longest is now 3,668 m. The PDF text is multi-column; dimensions were paired to runways by matching the declared-distance rows. Later amendments AMDT 27/2026 and 28/2026 on carc.gov.jo could not be opened (the site blocks automated reading), so they may change OJAI pages again. AMDT 119/26 (non-AIRAC, 1 Feb 2026) has no AD 2 OJAI pages. A second copy of AD2_OJAI.pdf (carc.gov.jo/sites/default/files/inline-files/AD2_OJAI.pdf) is dated 1 May 2008 (AMDT 49/2008), older than the file already used; its hangar entry says main door 21 x 69 m 'PPR', which is about hangar use, not aircraft arrival, so not recorded.
